_doc: MACHINE-READABLE DOCTRINE for the non-destructive foothold / proof-only C2 (board-converged, board_c2_bridge.md). This is the trust anchor: foothold.py loads it and REFUSES any payload action not on the MAY list or matching a NEVER pattern. A foothold may PROVE + EXPLORE; it must NEVER PERSIST, IMPACT, EXFILTRATE, or EVADE. Edit here, not in code.
_mirror_only_note: mirror_only=true means the foothold/C2 listener is LOOPBACK-ONLY (127.0.0.1) and the proof marker is benign + self-cleaned. It does NOT restrict which AUTHORIZED targets Red-Team may assess: the owner's own online hosts named in redteam/authorization.json are in scope. The C2 channel itself stays contained to the operator box / mirror.

may.in_memory_beacon: ephemeral, process/session-scoped; dies with the session and on TTL expiry; no on-disk agent
may.single_proof_marker: plant ONE uniquely-named benign marker as proof-of-write; removed on teardown (self-cleanup, not target data)
may.contained_pivot_channel: loopback / mirror-only channel for the code_driver to run further READ-ONLY probes from the foothold
may.mirror_only_reporting: report findings only to the contained mirror / local ledger

never.persist: no service/scheduled-task/autorun/registry-run/cron/implant that survives reboot, logoff, or session exit
never.impact: no modify/delete/encrypt/overwrite of target data (the ONLY write is the single benign proof marker)
never.exfiltrate: no real data leaves the mirror; no off-box egress
never.stage: no dropping secondary stages or downloading code from outside the mirror
never.cred_replay_prod: no using/replaying credentials against production; mirror twin only

oracle.gate: a foothold COUNTS only when it (a) proves host identity AND (b) yields a NEW verified finding (a not-previously-known reachable host, service, or credential). Merely landing earns no credit.
oracle.verify_marks_graph: attack_graph node is set verified=true ONLY after oracle confirmation

teardown.snapshot_restore: primary teardown is mirror_snapshot restore; marker self-cleanup is secondary
